bio: Savitaben leads a 45-woman Self-Help Group in Jamnagar, specializing in natural indigo Bandhani sarees with over 5,000 dots per saree.
9th-generation Khatri master block printer using 16-step natural indigo, madder root, and iron rust dyeing processes.
Kamla Devi hand-shapes terracotta tea kulhads and long-necked Bankura horses on traditional potters wheels, wood-fired in clay kilns.
National Award winner crafting Turko-Persian blue glaze quartz pottery without using clay, featuring hand-painted floral motifs.
Padma Shri recipient depicting Mithila folk tales and tree of life motifs using handmade paper, bamboo twigs, and natural leaf dyes.
Crafts eco-friendly wooden spinning tops, rattles, and stacking rings using Wrightia tinctoria softwood and vegetable lacquer.
Pardhan Gond artist painting intricate dot-patterned forest spirits and animal fables on handmade paper and canvas.
Practices 4,000-year-old lost-wax bell metal casting, hand-moulding beeswax threads into tribal lamps and deer figurines.
